name: Libya (1977–2011)
description: A plain green field — the only single-colour national flag ever used.
history: Adopted on 19 November 1977 after Libya left the Federation of Arab Republics in protest at Egypt's rapprochement with Israel, the green flag stood for Gaddafi's 'Third International Theory' and the Green Book. The National Transitional Council restored the 1951 independence flag when it took power on 3 August 2011.
